key_highlights: ASX supported by a rebound in mining and energy heavyweights, offsetting domestic macro headwinds.
Stubbornly high inflation data continues to exert upward pressure on interest rates, clashing with bond market expectations of rate cuts.
Consumer discretionary facing sharp pressure, evidenced by plunging foot traffic and profits at Harvey Norman.
Residential property under stress with accelerating price corrections in Brisbane and rising negative equity among first home buyers.
Federal gas reservation scheme nears parliamentary approval, introducing policy-driven shifts in domestic energy supply and pricing.

sectors.trend: Resources sector leading market gains supported by base and precious metals exploration activity.
sectors.implications: Broad index support via heavyweight miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX), with strong interest in junior gold developers.

sectors.trend: Rebound in energy equities alongside legislative progress on domestic gas reservation policy.
sectors.implications: Near-term revenue stability for large caps (WDS.AX, STO.AX), though domestic gas policy caps upside realization.

sectors.trend: Severe earnings compression and foot-traffic decline amid persistent inflation and reduced household spending.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for discretionary retailers (HVN.AX) and travel operators (FLT.AX) battling cost-of-living and operational headwinds.

sectors.trend: Mounting mortgage stress and negative equity amidst prolonged elevated cash rates.
sectors.implications: Headwinds for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX) via rising impairment charges and subdued credit growth.

sectors.trend: Residential price corrections and developer insolvency pressures creating broader market distress.
sectors.implications: Depressed valuations for residential REITs and construction supply-chain providers as completions peak.

key_themes: Resource rebound balancing domestic macro stagflation risks
RBA monetary policy dilemma between market rate cut hopes and elevated inflation
Household balance sheet deterioration squeezing retail and property sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent Inflation and Delayed RBA Easing
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain exposure to cash-generative equities with strong balance sheets and defensive pricing power.
Underweight cyclical retail and consumer travel; rotate into consumer staples and healthcare.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential Mortgage Distress and Credit Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank bad debt provisions and reduce exposure to non-bank lenders and speculative builders.
Focus on low-cost producers with uncommitted export capacity and diversified asset bases.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain Core Longs in Large-Cap Resources and Gold Producers
opportunities.rationale: Mining sector momentum and commodity resilience provide effective hedges against domestic inflation and currency swings.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to Diversified Upstream Energy
opportunities.rationale: Global energy demand and sector bounce underpin near-term cash flows despite local gas reservation schemes.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Discretionary Retail and High-Risk Travel Operators
defensive_moves.rationale: Plunging foot traffic and cyber breach impacts indicate ongoing margin erosion and customer friction.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Exposure to Rate-Sensitive Financials and Broad Index
defensive_moves.rationale: Negative equity and sticky inflation threaten bank provisions and risk multiple compression across the benchmark index.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as resources strength contends with retail profit warnings and rate uncertainty.
market_outlook.long_term: Challenging medium-term environment until inflation moderates sufficiently to allow RBA rate relief without worsening mortgage stress.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and statement commentary
Monthly and quarterly Australian CPI prints
Final parliamentary passage and terms of the gas reservation scheme
Corporate half-year earnings previews and trading updates
watch_list: Iron ore, gold, and LNG commodity spot prices
AUD/USD exchange rate dynamics against US dollar strength
Major bank 90+ day mortgage delinquency rates and loan loss provisions
Household consumption and retail turnover indicators
